items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I was listening to your duet with him, “Skylark.” ... So he sent me a demo and I played it ... I did like twelve takes on this thing

ctx.x: Yes. “I feel as though I have to call it something.”
Yeah, right, right, right. I was talking to Chick Corea about that because you know he’s very knowledgeable, you know.
Yeah. Well I have a Chick Corea question for later but we haven’t got there yet.
